blogs.name: Entrepreneurs.ng
blogs.verificationMethod: Same feed already verified for Tailoring & Fashion Design and POS/Agent Banking — cross-tagged here because it has multiple real, current (2026-dated) articles specifically on food business ideas in Nigeria: small chops, meal-prep subscriptions, snack production, startup costs and profit ranges by food type.

notes: Same shape as most Business-section categories so far: genuine, real human-interest content exists (a documentary on 'Mama Ese', a news feature on Rasheed Salami's Prestigious Meals redefining food hawking in Lagos) but nothing structured as ongoing business education — these are one-off features, not channels. The many food/recipe YouTubers found (Sussy's Cakes again, various 'What I Eat In A Day' channels) teach cooking, not running a food business, so weren't counted, consistent with the standard applied to Catering & Baking (skill_15) and other craft-vs-business distinctions this session.
